relative_path: ref_papers/radar_method_modules/05_multi_target_full_field/B41_Cross-range_displacement_measurement_using_a_single_MIMO_FMCW_radar.pdf
title: Cross-range displacement measurement using a single MIMO FMCW radar
method: 对MIMO-FMCW IF信号形成range-angle热图，并跟踪目标的距离和角度迁移。先补偿横向运动引起的range/angle migration相位，再解耦同时依赖距离和角度的相位项，用剩余相位估计cross-range displacement。
evidence_locator: PDF pp.1–2 abstract; §2.2 MIMO FMCW radar signal model; §3.1–3.2 phase compensation and range/angle demodulation; §5 experiments

relative_path: ref_papers/radar_method_modules/05_multi_target_full_field/B42_Simultaneous_displacement_and_rotation_estimation_for_flexible_structures_through_millimeter-wave_radar_and_inertial_sensor_fusion.pdf
title: Simultaneous displacement and rotation estimation for flexible structures through millimeter-wave radar and inertial sensor fusion
method: 从FMCW雷达相位得到结构LOS位移；用共址IMU加速度估计初始转角，并用雷达测量解耦平移分量。再用转换因子标定把LOS位移换为结构位移，并以误差优化融合初始转角和IMU角速度。
evidence_locator: PDF pp.1–2 abstract; §2.1 radar displacement with rotation; §2.2 radar–IMU rotation fusion; §2.3 conversion-factor calibration

relative_path: ref_papers/radar_method_modules/05_multi_target_full_field/B43_Non-contact_3D_displacement_measurement_of_structure_based_on_the_fusion_of_millimeter_wave_radar_and_digital_image_correlation.pdf
title: Non-contact 3D displacement measurement of structure based on the fusion of millimeter wave radar and digital image correlation
method: 用LFMCW雷达相位提取目标out-of-plane位移，用单目2D-DIC得到in-plane位移。根据观测点和目标点的水平/垂直角度做坐标映射，再把雷达与DIC分量标定后融合重建3D位移。
evidence_locator: PDF pp.1–2 abstract; §2.2 LFMCW radar and Z-axis extraction; §2.3 X/Y DIC extraction; §2.4 fusion methodology

relative_path: ref_papers/radar_method_modules/05_multi_target_full_field/C07_Using_Geometrical_Information_to_Measure_the_Vibration_of_a_Swaying_Millimeter-wave_Radar.pdf
title: Using Geometrical Information to Measure the Vibration of A Swaying Millimeter-wave Radar
method: 把环境中的参考物作为几何基准，利用雷达与参考物在不同时刻形成的面积差估计平面摆动位移。对空间摆动则利用参考物构成的体积差估计自振幅，并由几何变化给出粗略方向。
evidence_locator: PDF pp.1–2 abstract/introduction; §II planar-vibration area-difference method; §III spatial-vibration volume-difference method; experiment figures pp.3–4

relative_path: ref_papers/radar_method_modules/05_multi_target_full_field/Full-field 3D displacement measurement via microwave sensing.pdf
title: Full-field 3D displacement measurement via microwave sensing
method: 用三个不共线微波收发机和参考目标建立device/structural coordinate systems。把同一测点自动匹配到各雷达的range-angle热图，取得三个LOS位移，解三元几何方程并变换到结构坐标系得到全场3D位移。
evidence_locator: PDF pp.1–2 abstract; §2.1 basic principle and coordinate systems; §2.2–2.4 range-angle matching and 3D reconstruction

relative_path: ref_papers/radar_method_modules/05_multi_target_full_field/Millimeter-Wave Bat for Mapping and Quantifying Micromotions in Full Field of View.pdf
title: Millimeter-Wave Bat for Mapping and Quantifying Micromotions in Full Field of View
method: 用MIMO雷达生成range-angle联合热图，在每个目标位置跟踪慢时间复数相位演化以测量微动。用高通滤波抑制低频运动/温漂，并以目标相位历史的时变稀疏性与空间定位排除静态杂波后逐目标输出振动。
evidence_locator: PDF pp.1–2 abstract; §2.1 mmWBat system and range-angle tracking; §3 full-field mechanical vibration experiments; §4 clutter/TVS processing

relative_path: ref_papers/radar_method_modules/05_multi_target_full_field/Multi-scale and full-field vibration measurement via millimetre-wave sensing.pdf
title: Multi-scale and full-field vibration measurement via millimetre-wave sensing
method: 提出adaptive segmented phase demodulation（ASPD），根据位移尺度分段解调以覆盖微米到分米范围。对range-angle联合维度做改进的interferometric phase evolution tracking，分离邻近目标的耦合/混叠并逐目标恢复位移。
evidence_locator: PDF pp.1–2 abstract; §2 system overview; §3 ASPD and range-angle joint phase tracking; experimental sections

relative_path: ref_papers/radar_method_modules/06_gbsar_microwave_interferometry/B10_Measurement_Refinements_of_Ground-Based_Radar_Interferometry_in_Bridge_Load_Test_Monitoring.pdf
title: Measurement Refinements of Ground-Based Radar Interferometry in Bridge Load Test Monitoring: Comprehensive Analysis on a Multi-Span Cable-Stayed Bridge
method: 检测桥塔位移序列中的GB-radar phase jumps，删除异常跳变并恢复正确的unwrapped phase。投影计算中使用目标变形后的几何关系而非只使用初始LOS，从而补偿结构变形带来的厘米级投影误差，并保留沉降慢变趋势。
evidence_locator: PDF pp.1–2 abstract; §2–3 phase-jump detection/recovery and displacement projection; FNYRB load-test results

relative_path: ref_papers/radar_method_modules/06_gbsar_microwave_interferometry/B12_Analysis_of_bridge_dynamic_load_test_based_on_millimeter_wave_radar.pdf
title: Analysis of bridge dynamic load test based on millimeter wave radar
method: 对连续雷达回波相位做相邻采样干涉，得到目标LOS位移；根据雷达视线与桥梁几何关系把LOS分量投影成竖向挠度。再由位移时程和频谱提取一阶模态频率、车辆激励频率和冲击系数。
evidence_locator: PDF pp.1–3 abstract and bridge-deflection algorithm; equations (1)–(5) phase/interferometry projection; dynamic-load-test results

relative_path: ref_papers/radar_method_modules/06_gbsar_microwave_interferometry/Bridge Monitoring Strategies for Sustainable Development with Microwave Radar Interferometry.pdf
title: Bridge Monitoring Strategies for Sustainable Development with Microwave Radar Interferometry
method: 将极化分析与微波干涉结合，分别在RAR、SFCW线性合成孔径和MIMO阵列上获取桥梁响应。InSAR部分用双差相位去除平地/地形/噪声项，再用LOS投影向量解释变形分量，并从干涉位移时程给出频谱。
evidence_locator: PDF pp.1–2 abstract; §2.1 microwave radar interferometry (double-difference phase and LOS projection); §2.2 ground-based interferometry; bridge cases

relative_path: ref_papers/radar_method_modules/06_gbsar_microwave_interferometry/Ground-based radar interferometry for monitoring the dynamic performance of a multitrack steel truss high-speed railway bridge.pdf
title: Ground-Based Radar Interferometry for Monitoring the Dynamic Performance of a Multitrack Steel Truss High-Speed Railway Bridge
method: 使用IBIS-S地基微波干涉雷达，在多个距离单元和不同观测方位提取桥梁梁、轨道和附属构件的LOS位移。结合LiDAR点云解释目标空间位置和几何方向，并比较列车/地铁/风荷载时程及频谱以得到动态响应和空间变形图。
evidence_locator: PDF pp.1–4 abstract and radar setup; §3 bridge setting; §4 radar observations and dynamic-response interpretation with lidar

relative_path: ref_papers/radar_method_modules/06_gbsar_microwave_interferometry/Radar-based multipoint displacement measurements of a 1200-m-long suspension bridge.pdf
title: Radar-based multipoint displacement measurements of a 1200-m-long suspension bridge
method: 对每个距离单元的I/Q beat signal做FFT，同时读取频谱峰的相位并按干涉关系换算LOS位移。利用三个参考点估计桥梁/基座几何运动，对梁、塔、缆多点位移作修正，并绘制多点位移影响线。
evidence_locator: PDF pp.1–2 abstract; §3 radar equipment and signal processing; pp.73–75 FFT phase/displacement equations and three-reference-point field test

relative_path: ref_papers/radar_method_modules/07_radar_sensor_fusion/Accelerometer-aided millimeter-wave radar interferometry for uninterrupted bridge displacement estimation considering intermittent radar target occlusion.pdf
title: Accelerometer-aided millimeter-wave radar interferometry for uninterrupted bridge displacement estimation considering intermittent radar target occlusion
method: 初始阶段为多个雷达目标选择good targets并标定各自方向转换因子；目标可见时用加速度辅助相位解缠并在目标间切换。全部目标遮挡时用加速度重构位移，目标恢复后用多目标相位构造绝对解缠结果并消除遮挡造成的漂移。
evidence_locator: 本地扫描PDF无可提取文字；方法以出版社/机构摘要核验，另见 docs/radar_method_search_2010_2026/review_2026_10_08/decisions_fulltext_upgraded_v3.jsonl R1719；摘要关键词 target occlusion, displacement reconstruction, multitarget phase unwrapping

relative_path: ref_papers/radar_method_modules/07_radar_sensor_fusion/Continuous bridge displacement estimation using millimeter-wave radar, strain gauge and accelerometer.pdf
title: Continuous bridge displacement estimation using millimeter-wave radar, strain gauge and accelerometer
method: 从FMCW IF做FFT并用选定目标相位得到雷达位移；初始同步段自动选择目标并估计LOS到结构方向转换因子。雷达目标遮挡时以检测器切换到应变计ANN位移与加速度支路，恢复后用边界校正消除漂移并回到雷达—加速度FIR融合。
evidence_locator: PDF pp.1–3 abstract/flowchart; §2.1 radar-based displacement estimation; §2.2 strain-based displacement and occlusion switching; experiments pp.10–18

relative_path: ref_papers/radar_method_modules/07_radar_sensor_fusion/Development and field deployment validation of a low-cost and high-precision displacement sensing system by fusing millimeter-wave radar and accelerometer.pdf
title: Development and field deployment validation of a low-cost and high-precision displacement sensing system by fusing millimeter-wave radar and accelerometer
method: 用同步雷达—ADXL355短时数据自动筛选有效大振幅片段和最佳雷达目标，估计LOS到结构方向比例系数。运行时以加速度预测辅助相位解缠，再将雷达低频位移与加速度高频位移通过FIR互补滤波输出连续位移。
evidence_locator: PDF pp.2–6 §2 hardware and data-processing flow; p.3 ADXL355; §2.2 automatic calibration/phase unwrapping/FIR; pp.7–15 nine-structure validation

relative_path: ref_papers/radar_method_modules/07_radar_sensor_fusion/Improved structural acceleration estimation using low-cost MEMS   accelerometer and FMCW millimeter-wave radar.pdf
title: Improved structural acceleration estimation using low-cost MEMS accelerometer and FMCW millimeter-wave radar
method: 把FMCW雷达位移转换为低频结构加速度支路，把MEMS加速度作为高频支路。有限冲击响应互补滤波器合并两支路，输出的是结构加速度而不是位移；实验用LDV比较时域/频域并验证抑制MEMS漂移和雷达噪声。
evidence_locator: PDF pp.1–2 abstract; §2.2 structural acceleration estimation flow; FIR complementary-filter equations and laboratory/bridge validation

relative_path: ref_papers/radar_method_modules/07_radar_sensor_fusion/Structural Displacement Estimation of Rail Bridges Through Millimeter-Wave Radar, Accelerometers, and Non-Dedicated Multi-Modal Sensing.pdf
title: Structural Displacement Estimation of Rail Bridges Through Millimeter-Wave Radar, Accelerometers, and Non-Dedicated Multi-Modal Sensing
method: 共址60 GHz FMCW雷达与三轴MEMS加速度计采集同步数据，自动按雷达/加速度高频位移RMSE选择反射目标并标定方向转换因子。加速度辅助预测用于每个采样点的2π相位解缠，随后用FIR合并雷达和加速度位移；另以NTP同步的既有通信光纤做分布式应变扩展。
evidence_locator: 本地8页PDF对应全文文本 docs/radar_method_search_2010_2026/priority_fulltext/text/R1734.txt；abstract; Methodology pp.3–4; Fig.1–2 calibration, unwrap and FIR workflow

relative_path: ref_papers/radar_method_modules/07_radar_sensor_fusion/Structural displacement estimation using accelerometer and FMCW millimeter wave radar.pdf
title: Structural displacement estimation using accelerometer and FMCW millimeter wave radar
method: 从多个FMCW距离峰分别提取雷达相位，并用同步加速度双积分位移比较各候选目标的高频RMSE，选出best target和LOS转换因子。运行时用加速度辅助相位解缠，再用FIR把雷达低频位移和加速度高频位移合成为结构位移。
evidence_locator: 本地扫描PDF无可提取文字；方法由对应作者稿全文 docs/radar_method_search_2010_2026/priority_fulltext/text/R0001.txt 及审计记录核验；§ automatic calibration, acceleration-aided unwrap, FIR fusion

relative_path: ref_papers/radar_method_modules/08_radar_calibration_tracking/A Noncontact FMCW Radar Sensor for Displacement Measurement in Structural Health Monitoring.pdf
title: A Noncontact FMCW Radar Sensor for Displacement Measurement in Structural Health Monitoring
method: FMCW前端正交混频得到I/Q beat signal，DFT/FFT的频率峰给出距离、固定距离bin的相位变化给出高精度位移。通过多个不同距离目标的beat频率分离实现多目标测量，并用参考点几何关系推导3D位移的线性化解。
evidence_locator: PDF pp.1–2 abstract; §2 3-D displacement principle; §3.1 FMCW signal propagation/IQ; §3.2–3.4 DFT range/phase displacement and multi-target simulations

relative_path: ref_papers/radar_method_modules/08_radar_calibration_tracking/Anchor-Based, Real-Time Motion Compensation for High-Resolution mmWave Radar.pdf
title: Anchor-Based, Real-Time Motion Compensation for High-Resolution mmWave Radar
method: 从场景中选取静态anchor回波，把平台复杂运动映射为复数相位/频率调制项。用anchor估计并反卷积补偿非谐瞬态和多模态谐振造成的谱展宽，再在低延迟约束下恢复目标距离/速度谱。
evidence_locator: PDF pp.1–2 abstract; §II complex motion model; §III anchor-based compensation and deconvolution; §V real-time validation

relative_path: ref_papers/radar_method_modules/08_radar_calibration_tracking/Incoherent Interference Detection and Mitigation for Millimeter-Wave FMCW Radars.pdf
title: Incoherent Interference Detection and Mitigation for Millimeter-Wave FMCW Radars
method: 对接收复信号取幅值并用低通FIR检测干扰包络，把标记干扰区当作缺失数据。将回波恢复写成L1正则最小二乘问题，使用ADMM求解并重建受干扰的FMCW echo。
evidence_locator: PDF pp.1–2 abstract; §3.1 interference-envelope detection; §3.2 missing-data labels; §3.3 L1 least-squares and ADMM; pp.11–18 validation

relative_path: ref_papers/radar_method_modules/08_radar_calibration_tracking/Multiple-target tracking and track management for an FMCW radar network.pdf
title: Multiple-target tracking and track management for an FMCW radar network
method: 直接在beat-frequency measurement space把每个chirp的测量与已有track关联，避免先计算range/range-rate和多边定位。逐chirp处理把数据关联分解为二维assignment，再用轨迹初始化、更新和删除规则管理杂波中的多目标track。
evidence_locator: PDF pp.1–2 abstract/introduction; §2 tracking with FMCW radar networks; §3 association/track initiation and deletion; §4 Monte Carlo

relative_path: ref_papers/radar_method_modules/08_radar_calibration_tracking/Recent Advances in mmWave-Radar-Based Sensing, Its Applications, and Machine Learning Techniques: A Review.pdf
title: Recent Advances in mmWave-Radar-Based Sensing, Its Applications, and Machine Learning Techniques: A Review
method: 综述IF信号到range profile、range–azimuth heatmap和3D scatter plot的解释链，并汇总CFAR、DBSCAN、点云分割、特征/数据级融合和深度学习模块。它是方法索引和来源导航，不应作为单一算法实验依据。
evidence_locator: PDF pp.1–2 abstract; §2 performance metrics; §3 range profile/range–azimuth/3D interpretation; §4 applications and ML table

relative_path: ref_papers/radar_method_modules/08_radar_calibration_tracking/Transversal Displacement Detection of an Arched Bridge with a Multimonostatic Multiple-Input Multiple-Output Radar.pdf
title: Transversal Displacement Detection of an Arched Bridge with a Multimonostatic Multiple-Input Multiple-Output Radar
method: 分别对单站和多单站FMCW-MIMO复回波沿快时间FFT取得距离，再用相邻采样相位差换算LOS位移。雷达与同步transponder形成两个不同LOS观测，解2×2几何方程得到桥面水平/竖向分量，并用误差传播预测几何不确定度。
evidence_locator: PDF pp.1–2 abstract; §2.1 data processing (FFT and phase displacement); §2.2 geometry; §2.3 uncertainty evaluation; §3 multimonostatic bridge result

relative_path: ref_papers/radar_method_modules/08_radar_calibration_tracking/多径利用雷达目标探测技术综述与展望.pdf
title: 多径利用雷达目标探测技术综述与展望 / Overview and Prospects of Multipath Exploitation Radar Target Detection Technology
method: 综述空中和地面平台的多径利用雷达链路：多径传播建模与回波提取、距离/多普勒/角度检测、镜像几何定位、波束形成/RMA/MSBP成像和多径目标跟踪。文章用于补充NLOS/多径模块来源，不代表本课题的单一测振算法。
